summary: A panel beside the control that opens it, for content the user can act on without leaving the page.

open.description: It is showing. A script adds and removes it.

root.note: An inline box around the control that opens it; it is the anchor the content is placed against.

content.note: The panel: the author marks it with data-part="content". It gets the dialog role and shows in the top layer while open.

keys.Enter: On the control, opens or closes the panel. Opening moves focus to the panel's first focusable element, or to the panel.
keys.Space: On the control, opens or closes the panel.
keys.Escape: Closes the panel and returns focus to the control. The Escape goes no further, so a layer around the popover stays open.
keys.Tab: Moves focus out of the panel at its end, which closes it.

events.toggle: Dispatched after the panel opens or closes.

guidance.text: The control is the popover's first child that is not the content. It gets aria-haspopup, aria-expanded and aria-controls. It opens the popover by its click, so Enter and Space work on a control that clicks on them: the kit's button or a native button. Any other element needs its own keys.
The author names the panel with aria-label or aria-labelledby on the content part.
Each opening, from a script too, moves focus into the panel. The panel gets tabindex="-1" unless the author wrote a tabindex, so that it can take focus when nothing inside it can.

notYet: A choice of side: the panel shows below the control, and above where it does not fit.
